Lines.Line: Excuse me sir, Before you go tell me...
Does it make me a bad person if i doubt my husband ?
I feel like I made a mistake by chosing him, he changed...
I would need one of your drinks again, it really helped me the other day.
From now on I think I'll only care about me and my three childrens...
I saw him here recently, I hope he's not causing you any trouble.
I no longer have powers on his choices anyway.
All I can do is hoping he's not doing anything...
I feel like he's changing but it's still not enough, he lost my trust.
Now he will have to regain it by himself hmph!
Don't repeat this to him please.
Aah, it kills me to ignore him, it's not in my habits.
But on the other hand i'm so tired.
I want him to do something for me, for once.
He brought me flowers...
I cried so hard and still want to right now.
Thanks to you he came back the same as he was before.
So sincerely thank you for healing us, me and my husband.
Hi little bear, with this little amount of clients you would need a loan right?
With very small interests for me of course.
how is this place still standing?
I thought I paid the health inspection group enough, grrrr.
This place is trash and everybody will know it!
I saw my wife coming here...
you know what?
Maybe the coffee isn't that bad after all.
Your coffees made my generosity come back after all this time.
Maybe the love for my wife can come back too...
Ahhhh i really needed this drink.
I understand now why your shop is working so well.
It can heal people when they hit the ground, even if it's me.
My wife still doesn't look at me, what can I do?
I went to the flower shop near here.
It's been so long since I offered her flowers that it's make me anxious.
I really needed one of your drinks, wish me luck!
My wife was so happy when I gave her the flowers.
I feel like our love is coming back!
I will handle everything from now on.
It's crazy to me that I wanted to close this place.
And now I'm telling you about my life without even realizing.
I can't thank you enough please forgive me, I hope will be friend.
I finally finished my studies.
Nothing beats a muffin and a hot chocolate as a reward.
I would never think that finding a job in what makes you happy would be so hard.
Thank god there's still a shop like yours around here to get loose a little bit.
I found a company that looks pretty cool!
I contacted them and they said we need to do three meetings to know if I'm hired, I can do this!
The first appointment is so close, I absolutely need to finish my portfolio, I have to work harder!
The first appointment was a success, I'm so proud of myself!
I need to get ready for the next appointment.
This time I need to be better and well prepared!
It was soooo stressing but I succeeded, Only one appointment left!
I need to work harder, faster, better, stronger, more!
I can't believe it...
I thought I did good during the apointment...
I didn't got hired...
I worked so much, Why it didn't work...
I'm still looking for a job...
What can I do...
I'm bad at everything...
I guess I'll just sit here, and try to find something else...
All I need is another hot chocolate...
I dont have the strengtht today...
I can't find a good company...
I just want to give up...
The founder of a new company texted me on Inkdin.
He seems nice, I'll talk to him and see where this goes.
I've met, the new founder!!!
We even talked about our lives, I would really like to be his friend, he's so inspiring!
Youhou, I'm hired, I'm one of the first employees!
I finally managed to do something of my life that's fabulous!
I left my previous company and I'm finally creating mine now.
No one wants to give me a loan to make my company, what can I do...
A banker contacted me recently but he seems...
Weird and fake.
I don't trust him, you know him perchance?
The banker of the last time, I did good by being wary of him.
You were right, He made a recent company fall because of his scams!
But I still end up with no money..., I need to find a way.
I applied for government funding, I hope I'll receive something from them.
I also have an appointment to find a location for the company.
Aaah, I also really needed this drink.
The town was able to give me enough money, I can rent the place!
I’m going to find people willing to work on the project now!
I started setting up the place with some stuff.
The government support might not be enough.
Now I need someone to make some visuals for the company.
I’m going to look on Inkdin.
Okay, I looked around and added some interesting profiles.
I’m waiting for responses, but anyway, do you remember the banker?
He contacted me again to apologize for his behavior.
Do you think I can trust him?
I had a meeting with the banker today.
I feel like he has really changed since our first interaction.
I’m going to give him a chance, I just hope I won’t regret it.
The contract I signed seems fine!
I was able to get a loan without very high interest rates!
I’ll be able to hire people, and on top of that, I got a positive response from a young woman on Inkdin.
I’m going to meet her!
The meeting went really well.
She seems motivated and more than qualified!
You can tell she has worked hard, I want her on my team!
I’m going to contact her to tell her I’m hiring her!
I managed to recruit a small team!
We’re starting the project production right now!
I hope people will like it.
I’m going to get drinks and pastries for my whole team!
Do you believe these rumors ?
I could never do those things, How can people believe something like this.
He got chose and not me, It could've never be so bad.
I'm sure he's the one spreading these rumors
I proved them the rumors were wrong, I hope justice will be done.
To get my revenge I’m going to find another casting.
I found a new casting I'm going to go to the auditions.
I hope they will like me.
I passed easily, I got the leading role!!!
I also wanted to thank you, your drinks and your care helped me to hold on.
Thank you for this drink sir, I will be back
You're working hard...
Not like these stupid males in my company, sorry I carried myself away a little bit.
Those from my company underestimate me so bad!
They think i'm here to serve coffee, no offense of course.
I'll show them that I can improve and manage the company better than them.
Ugh, I can’t take these guys anymore.
They managed to steal my work, claim it as their own, and they got promotions.
I have to prove to the boss that the work presented to him was mine.
Hah, I really needed a tea.
Ahh, I feel really good thanks to your drinks.
Thank you… Teddy, this really is the perfect place to relax.
I wasn’t able to prove to my boss that my colleagues "work" actually belonged to me.
But you know what?
It’s not that serious.
After all, it’s my work I know its flaws, and I’m going to do better than that.
I did another piece of work that improves the model I made before, haha!
I’ll be able to reduce my colleagues "work" to zero.
This time, I made sure to sign all my documents.
Haha, I got promoted, and all my associates were demoted.
The boss must have realized that they hadn’t done any of their work.
Hi, do you have any parsley drinks?
No?
But do you know how good parsley is for your health?
Ahh, I should bring you one of my parsley-based beauty products one day.
Here’s the product I told you about last time, made with parsley.
It's a thank you for your delicious drinks.
Oh, I can already see on your skin that you’ve used my product, you look more radiant!
That’s why my product works all over the country.
Now I just need a transporter to import it abroad, but the last two tricked me.
I don’t know how I’m going to find a trustworthy one.
I found one!
I found a transporter.
We talked, and he seems really nice.
My product is finally going to be sold internationally.

Name: All bad things come in threes

Lines.Line:
You know when I told you about a transporter… 
The merchandise disappeared again… I think I’m going to give up on my project.
It’s already incredible that my product is known in the country.
Ahh, your plants and the cherry tree at the entrance give so much style to your coffee, I love it.
I’ll definitely come back, that’s for sure.
You know, I’m a shop owner too, I’m a florist.
Come see me one day, I’m not far from here.
I’d love to show you some decoration ideas and maybe supply you with plants.
Thank you for stopping by last time.
I hope I was a source of inspiration for your future decorations.
I didn’t mention it to you last time, but I have a project and I need your help.
I want to create a garden and I need money for that.
I was wondering if you know anyone who could give me a loan.
So you know someone then?
That’s so cool, I hope they’ll agree to give me a loan, I'm aware of how crazy my project might be.

Guess what… 
my loan got approved!!!
It’s thanks to you, Teddy, thank you so much.
Now get ready, because we start the construction.
Ahh Teddy, I could never thank you enough.
My dream came to life with your help.
You know what, I’ll give you unlimited flowers for free, I think it’s only normal between friends, and it’s my way of thanking you.
The saxophone is so amazing, I’d love to be able to make a living playing it.
It’s decided, I’m going to try the music conservatory.
Well, conservatories are way too expensive for me, so I’m going to start a TikTok account.
The beginnings on TokTok are tough, but I’m not giving up I’m going to make it.
I spotted a bat who makes amazing drawings, I’m going to ask him if he can beautify my profile.
He agreed, woohoo!
My TokTok account looks amazing now.
I never would have thought that so many people could be interested in me.
I could never thank Nox enough.
A conductor wants me in his orchestra it’s the happiest day of my life!
I work as a night guard with my sister, but this job bores me.
I’d really like to start my own business and share my drawings with the whole world
I created an account to post my drawings.
For now, I only have about fifty followers, but that’s pretty nice!
Have you ever met my sister?
She streams when she’s not working.
She just got affiliated, so I made her some emotes!
People on social media love this kind of art!
I had a fight with my sister this morning.
I don’t want to see her anytime soon, she really acts like a child.
Living with her is so unpleasant.
I had just asked her to tidy up the apartment.

Name: Get up on the wrong side of the bad

Lines.Line: The night was tough, I’d like to have a little snack while I draw before going home.
Can I draw you working?
I’ll tag you in the post

Name: Restless nights
Requirements: Get up on the wrong side of the bad

Lines.Line: I barely slept because of my sister, she’s so noisy… Sometimes I think I should find my own apartment and let her live on her own.
Hmm, have you seen my sister recently?
We hardly talk anymore, and...
I’m starting to miss her, she’s my twin, and I feel bad for yelling at her last time.
I’d like to reconcile with her.
I made a fanart for my sister and posted it on my social media.
People loved it, I’ve gained quite a few followers.
I’ll see her after my shift, I hope she’ll forgive me.
I reconciled with my sister!
She was also sad that we argued and regrets what she said.
I’m glad we’re talking normally again.
I’ve reached ten thousand followers!
I can’t believe so many people are following me!
It’s also thanks to my sister she’s always promoted my work on her channel, I love her.
Hello!
I work at a shop around here, and I just finished my night shift!
I’m here to grab a little sweet treat before going home.
I also need to plan my streaming schedule for this week which is my dream of living from my passion!
Heyyy!
You must have met my brother last time!
He draws a lot, and I told him to create an account, haha.
By the way, make sure to subscribe to my channel!
I’m trying to get affiliated!
HIIII, I just got my affiliation!
To celebrate this, nothing beats a sweet coffee please, and a pastry.
I can’t believe it I absolutely need some emotes!!!
I got an amazing collab offer with another streamer!
More subs!
I was supposed to tidy up the apartment, but this is way more important!
I’m going to prepare the schedule of what we’re going to do right away!
My brother is getting on my nerves.
I broke the office printer, and the coffee machine died.
Please, give me something to recharge I have a huge stream waiting for me when I get home!
This 24 hour live stream was really exhausting!
I gained quite a few subs I’m at three hundred!
But I made too much noise, and my stupid brother yelled at me in the middle of the live… So embarrassing!
He annoys me so much, I wish I could live in my own place
My brother talks to me less and less, I feel like he’s avoiding me.
I may have gone too far, I regret yelling at him, after all it was my fault.
I did a little promo for my brother on my live.
I made things clear to my viewers they loved the argument, haha!
I gained quite a few subs from that, but I still want my brother to come back and talk to me.
Hey, did you see my brother’s beautiful drawing?
I love it so much, I set it as my profile picture for my channel, and my viewers loved the change!
I’m not far from a thousand sub!
I just need a little more effort!
One thousand sub, I did it, amazing!
My brother made me a gorgeous banner for the occasion!
I’m going to give him tons of publicity it’s party time!
Hi, I’m Adélaïde.
I saw your café when leaving my pilates class, and it looked so cool and now here I am!
I’ll come back more often.
Hey, I thought of you and I was wandering if you'd like to work out with me during your breaks.
I’m planning to offer you the sessions since I’m the manager.
Hi Ted, thanks for your drink.
I forgot my problems for a few seconds, but well, my mom is still seriously ill.
I’d like to get some drinks to go, please is that possible?
Hey Teddy, would you like to go out with me tonight?
If I wait for you after work?
Haha, your expression says it all see you later then.
Hi Teddy, I don’t know who else to talk to besides you.
My mom is in an hospital in Australia.
I don’t know what to do, I’m just looking for a way to lift myself up luckily your drinks exist…
Sorry if I’m not suggesting to go out or if I’m coming less often.
But the hospital fees and travels are extremely expensive, I have to work a lot.

Name: The light at the end of the tunnel

Lines.Line: I finally managed to pay everything so my mom can be treated.

Now I just hope these treatments will actually help… 
Meanwhile, my mom is asking me for another drink to go, haha.

Name: Mom is safe
Requirements: The light at the end of the tunnel

Lines.Line: My mom is saved Teddy, yay!
I’m actually sure your drinks helped her more than the treatments, I thank you from the bottom of my heart!
Hi Teddy, now that everything is going well in my life, I can finally tell you what I really feel...
I’m in love with you.
Would you want to be with me..?
Haha, I understand by looking at your expression I’ll wait for you after work!
This coffee is very nice, my good sir.
You’ve just gotten yourself a new regular customer, hehe!
Would you mind if I post a review of your restaurant on my blog?
And if it reassures you, it’s a very positive one.
I’m going to Paris to explore the gastronomy there.
I’ll share my experiences with you.
Well, in the end, I’m not bringing you anything at all my flight was cancelled.
I really needed one of your drinks.
I haven’t told you, by the way, but I’m writing my gastronomy book.
That’s why I want to travel a lot.
Paris is one of my last destinations.
That’s it I managed to get another flight to Paris.
This time, there’s no way my flight will be cancelled.
I’m almost finished writing my recipe book.
It’s the end, but it’s the part where I need to be the most focused to make sure I haven’t made any mistakes!
I finally finished my book, now I need a publisher.
That’s it I found my publisher!
I’m sure my book will be a reference in gastronomy!
My book is out, and to thank you for listening to me and making so many delicious drinks, I’m giving you my book.
I dedicated a page to showcase some of your recipes.
The lighting and the vibe of this café are perfect for taking photos.
Did you design all of this?
Haha, you don’t seem like it.
Please don’t ruin the lighting, I’m doing a product placement here.
I used a parsley-based mask you can clearly see the difference, right?
HAHAHA, my number of followers has increased so much since I started taking photos here.
I guess I should thank you for letting me take photos here.
Well, the Pilates studio is closed for who knows what reason this time.
I’m just here for the nice drinks i mean nice, but nothing more, okay?
Don’t you dare think it’s my favorite place or something.
I don’t have any more collaborations to do for my social media, but I still have to keep appearing perfect for people to come...
No one is interested in me despite all the effort I put in.
They only think about my appearance.
I should be proud of that, but no one cares about what’s inside my plumage.
You too, right?
Today, a little nervous bunny at Pilates asked me why I looked sad, even though I didn’t look sad at all, haha… Who does this little guy think he is?
So I came here to straighten out my thoughts.
Nothing to do with sadness
I saw that nervous little bunny from last time again.
I found him cute at the moment and asked him out I don’t know what came over me.
What must he think about me
The date went so well with that little bunny.
I really felt listened I felt like someone was interested in me for who I am and not for what I show.
He told me his little heart was broken and that he couldn’t get into a relationship so soon, but I’m ready to wait.
I’m in a relationship yes!
I finally found my other half!
The first thing I’m going to do is bring him here.
I did a photoshoot with my lover.
I told everyone that I found the love of my life, and they all said we look great together.
Hi, thanks for the drink, it was really good I really needed it.
The person I love just told me I’m too weak for her.
Maybe it’s true, but it hurts.
I don’t know if you can tell, but I’ve been taking pilates classes to get stronger.
I’m not letting myself get discouraged
Well, in the end I was the only problem it had nothing to do with strength.
She cut ties with me, all I have left now are your drinks and pilates…
I talked to a peacock yesterday, he was gorgeous and smiling.
But something was off, he seemed sad.
I asked him why he was like this, but he denied it.
What got into me to ask him that?
I wanted to get closer to him, and now he must hate me.
Maybe I should work on my tact instead of my strength.
I made myself really small at the pilates studio so the peacock wouldn’t notice me, and then, out of nowhere, he asked me out.
I thought I was going to have a heart attack.
I said yes while trembling, but what must he be thinking of me.
The date with Leon was amazing.
He reassured me about all the things I’ve been put down for before, and I found him super interesting.
I could listen to him talk all day, but I don’t feel ready to be in a relationship just yet.
That’s it, it’s official I’m in a relationship with Leon!
I’m so happy that someone loves my flaws.
We did a photoshoot recently.
I felt a bit uncomfortable at first, but seeing ourselves in the photos afterwards made me want to do it again.
Thank you for letting us take photos and for giving us amazing drinks Teddy.
